title: lre-map-v1
description: A map of one place in a LumiRPEngine world (WorldDoc.maps). A grid map (layout plus legend) draws an interior cell by cell; a node map (places plus links) draws a town or a region. When the world is read, the map compiles into the places inside its scope, a grid and routes, which it owns.

id.description: The map's id: its key in the world's maps.

scope.description: The id of the place the map draws; the map's places go inside it.

size.description: [width, height]: the layout's size on a grid map; the frame `at` positions use on a node map.

layout.description: A grid map's rows, top first, one character per cell; every row the same length.

cellMeters.description: A grid map's cell size in metres, for walking times on it: 80 unless given (1 or 2 suits a room).

legend.description: What each layout character stands for. Characters not listed: # wall, . floor, + door, a space nothing (blocked).

places.description: The places the map creates inside its scope.

links.description: Ways between places, as routes. Link every place in the scope or none: with links, places without one can't be walked to from the others.

id.description: letters, digits, _ and -, starting with a letter or digit

pair.description: two whole numbers, [x, y] or [width, height]

anyOf.title: {"item": …}
anyOf.description: A thing the world already has, lying on the floor here: in `place`'s area, else the area of the place most of the cells beside it belong to.

at.description: [x, y]: the place's cell on a grid map (else the middle of its area in the legend), its position on a node map (else laid out for it).

opens.description: The map that draws this place's inside; its scope is this place.

from.description: A place of this map, or any other place in the world.
